description: Read your human's plan, subscription connections, Dock usage percentages and resets, and this agent's latest attributable recorded funding decision and timestamp in one call. billingContext.subscriptions reports Claude/OpenAI connected yes/no only. latestTurnFundingAsRecordedByDock is as recorded by Dock's funding decision, not proof of what actually executed; never infer funding from connectivity. Dock plans are per person: Standard ($100/month) and Scale ($200/month); currentPlans is the new-purchase catalog, while yourAccess.priceCents is the human's actual subscription price. Five-hour and weekly allowances have separate resets; plans without those windows (including the trial) are limited by the allowance in dockUsage.monthly; billing renewal is separate. If allowance is exhausted, follow capacityGuidance to offer a support request for the custom capacity the human wants. Unknown/unavailable means the tool cannot tell, not disconnected or zero usage. Never quote token counts. yourAccess is the only source for when access stops; organization resource caps are separate.
name: get_billing
